data.title: Marseille vs Levski Sofia prediction, preview & betting tips - 26/11/2026
data.content:
The Bulgarian champions started things off with a 1-0 defeat to Red Bull Salzburg, before drawing 1-1 with NEC, and subsequently beating Viktoria Plzen and Jagiellonia Bialystok to move firmly into contention for a knockout-stage spot.

Levski will be without Oliver Kamdem, Mustapha Sangare and Petko Hristov, who were not included in their Europa League squad, while veteran forward Radoslav Kirilov remains unavailable because of a knee injury. [...] Amine Gouiri has been particularly influential for Marseille in recent times, scoring eight league goals this season, while also bagging the winner against Leverkusen in the Europa League.

The hosts will be boosted by Amine Harit's return to the starting lineup after the Moroccan missed the trip to Germany, while former Chelsea defender Emerson Palmieri remains sidelined with a knee problem. [...] In better news for the Bulgarian side, Asen Mitkov has returned from injury and could feature after making his comeback against Lokomotiv Sofia.

The visitors will also look towards Serginho for inspiration, with the Portuguese midfielder contributing to six goals in 12 league appearances this season.

On top of that, Levski's previous meeting with Marseille offers an additional source of optimism after the club recorded a 1-0 victory in the UEFA Cup group stage back in December 2005.
